summary: All 11 selected items are concrete, attributed, and within the 6-11 target. Coverage spans the DeepSeek DSpark open-source release, the China-vs-US-lab capability narrative, compute-driven access limits, model-identity reporting, AI-market sentiment, UK sovereign AI, an Amodei open-source argument, a practitioner downstream story, a research paper, and an executive hiring quote. No two selected items are hard duplicates of the same event and angle, so no replacements are required. Two adjacent pairs are noted as same-topic/distinct-angle: Polymarket vs pmarca (both Chinese-model-beats-US-labs, but bug-finding benchmark vs broad insider positioning) and Yuchenj_UW DSpark vs nunkeai's downstream draft-model build. The reserve pool's US government AI-access cluster (AnthropicAI Mythos 5 redeployment, GPT-5.6 access rejection, Lutnick call) is a coherent secondary story only lightly represented via the Cosine sovereign-LLM item; flagged as a coverage gap rather than a blocking issue. The DSpark duplicate within the pool itself (danielhanchen vs the selected Yuchenj_UW) is correctly left in reserve.

The reserve pool contains a coherent, very high-reach US government AI-access story (AnthropicAI: Mythos 5 redeployment to critical-infrastructure orgs at 4.2M views; JinjingLiang: GPT-5.6 preview rejection / government-handpicked access; shashj: Lutnick caution to Altman).
